analytic-story.description: Splunk Security Content analytic story / use case grouping this detection belongs to.

app.description: Splunk app or add-on namespace the search runs in (e.g. Splunk Enterprise Security, ES Content Update).

comment.description: A description of the Splunk detection/correlation search.

data-source.description: Sourcetype(s), index(es), or data model(s) queried by the search.

known-false-positives.description: Known false positives or limitations of the detection.

mitre-attack-id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID(s) associated with the detection.

reference.description: Reference URL for the detection source or documentation.

risk-score.description: Risk score assigned to the detection (0-100).

rule-id.description: Unique identifier of the detection, such as the Splunk Security Content id field.

rule-name.description: Human-readable name of the Splunk detection/correlation search.

schedule.description: Search schedule or cron_schedule the detection runs on.

spl.description: Search Processing Language (SPL) query implementing the detection.

description: An object describing a Splunk detection/correlation search (SPL query), its scheduling, risk scoring, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, following the Splunk Security Content (ESCU) detection format.
name: splunk-rule
